summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments by triaging, implementing fixes, running tests, committing, and replying to/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: 5 of 6 threads fixed (1 marked not applicable), all 57 unit tests passing, changes committed and pushed across 4 files.

repo: cipher-box is a monorepo with packages: crypto, sdk, and tests/e2e
crypto/README.md maintains a manual API list that must be kept in sync with exports (deriveIpnsName, generateIv, generateCtrIv, clearAll were missing)
sdk/client.ts uses clearBytes for secure key material cleanup — already imported
E2E tests use a multi-account-wallet utility that creates Playwright browser contexts per account

code.finding: fileKey was not cleared in a finally block — if an exception occurred before the re-wrap try/catch, the key would leak in memory; fixed by wrapping the post-upload section in try/finally
Lifecycle hooks could throw and break operations; fixed with error isolation so hook exceptions don't propagate
Concurrent mutations to the same folder can lose updates — acknowledged architectural concern, deferred as out of scope for this extraction PR
180s timeout too tight for 3 sequential wallet logins; increased
Playwright browser contexts leaked on partial failure during account creation; fixed with cleanup on failure path

workflow: Used GraphQL reviewThreads query to fetch isResolved status for PR threads
REST API requires --field (not -f) for integer parameters like in_reply_to when replying to review comments
Ran SDK-specific tests (pnpm test scoped to packages/sdk) rather than waiting for full monorepo test suite

friction: Unit test run hung or was slow — had to use TaskOutput to poll status, then fell back to running SDK tests directly
Had to read client.ts multiple times at different offsets to get full context for the fileKey finally-block restructure
A stale lock file required removal before the final commit could complete
open_items: Concurrent mutation safety for same-folder operations (sdk/client.ts:360) — marked not applicable for this PR but flagged as a real architectural concern to address separately
